name: weekly-close
description: Friday afternoon: what moved, what is now inactive, what is still unvalidated.

steps.produces: A per-project line: stage, next irreversible action, and whether it moved this week.
rules: A project with no next action is reported inactive, not ongoing.
A project with no demand evidence is reported unvalidated, not bad.
Feedback entries still classified local are listed but not promoted.

escalate_if: A project has been EXECUTE with no next action for three consecutive weeks.
_status: declarative only — no runner is wired to this yet, by design
